pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, stellate dark brown regions with sharp, non-linear edge gradients. Features include acute-angled vertices and variable spatial area across the flank and neck segments.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quadri-radial connectivity with uniform pixel thickness across the central flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal neck and shoulder line against the background.
